rules.note: Electronic copy of your ID or passport, uploaded with the grant registration form.
Copy of your school certificate. Upload it with its supplement. Documents in other languages need a notarised translation into Kazakh, Russian or English.
The supplement (marks) that comes with your school certificate. Every mark on all pages counts, and the grant asks for a score of 4.50 out of 5 (90%).
Valid IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, Duolingo, CEFR, Cambridge FCE, LanguageCert or PTE Academic copy, if you have one. The grant asks for about IELTS 5.5 (B2).
Certificates for prizes in national or international olympiads and competitions from the last three years (school grades 9 to 11), if you have them.
Digital photo in the Photo field of the KIMEP application: JPEG, 300 ppi, at least 8 MP, high quality.
For KIMEP admission: bank statement showing at least USD 3,000 for one semester of tuition, or the letter awarding you a scholarship.
For KIMEP admission: criminal record certificate, as required by Kazakhstan's migration law.
For KIMEP admission: vaccination records and medical examination form 075 with chest X-ray, handed to the KIMEP Medical Center on arrival in Almaty.
